Question 6
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded between y=x2+2x−9 and y=2x+7?

a
∫−41(x2−4)dx
b
∫−22(8−x2)dx
c
∫−44(16−x2)dx
d
∫−44(16+4x2)dx
e
∫−14(4−x2)dx
